label: rem:jones-markov-trace-stabilisation
title: Negative stabilisation and the Jones normalisation parameter
html: Stabilisation by \sigma_n^{-1} is forced by the Hecke quadratic relation: \mathrm{tr}_M(x \sigma_n^{-1}) = z_{-}\,\mathrm{tr}_M(x) with z_{-} = z - (q - q^{-1}) (Markov axioms). The two loop values are distinct, and invariance of the resulting link polynomial under both Markov moves is achieved by a writhe-dependent prefactor outside the trace, not by symmetry of the trace itself. The Jones link-invariant normalisation parameter z_{\mathrm{J}} = (q-1)\,z^2 that absorbs this prefactor is distinct from z (reconciliation of the Markov parameter z).
